title: PolyDiff QR-Family Fact Vector
description: Per-implementation fact vector for the qr family. Sibling of fact-vector.schema.json (URL family), fact-vector-image.schema.json (image family), fact-vector-opengraph.schema.json (opengraph family), and fact-vector-deeplink.schema.json (deeplink family); all share input_id + parser_profile as the cross-family identity keys that the diff engine pairs vectors on. Axes follow the T-M2.5 spec (10 axes): detected_text, ecc_level, version, mode, encoding_charset, structured_append_index, structured_append_total, fnc1_present, parser_warnings, decode_outcome. When a wrapper binary/package is absent (e.g. ZXing, ZBar, Apple Vision or iOS Camera detector toolchain is not installed in the devcontainer) the wrapper emits a crash envelope with binary_missing=true and decode_outcome.status='parse_error'; that envelope still validates so the missing parser stays auditable in the diff report.

binary_missing.description: Set by the wrapper when the underlying QR-decoder binary/package is not available. The qr axes are then null and decode_outcome.status MUST be 'parse_error'.

detected_text.description: The text payload decoded from the QR symbol. null when the wrapper produced no observable decoded text (parse_error / binary_missing / no_qr_found). Same-input divergence in detected_text is the URL-in-QR phishing-surface signal.

ecc_level.description: QR error-correction level: L (~7%), M (~15%), Q (~25%), H (~30%). null when not observable.

version.description: QR version (1-40). Determines symbol size and capacity. null when not observable.

mode.description: QR data mode. Same-input divergence indicates charset-confusion class (e.g. mode picked as 'kanji' vs 'byte' for identical symbol input).

encoding_charset.description: Inferred byte-mode character set (e.g. 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1', 'Shift-JIS'). null when the parser doesn't report charset or mode is non-byte. ECI-tagged vs default charset divergence surfaces here.

structured_append_index.description: Zero-based index in a multi-QR structured-append sequence. null when the symbol is standalone (no structured-append header).

structured_append_total.description: Total number of symbols in the structured-append sequence. null when standalone.

fnc1_present.description: Whether the QR symbol carries an FNC1 header (GS1 application identifiers). null when not observable.

parser_warnings.description: Implementation-emitted warnings (e.g. 'low-confidence decode', 'partial structured-append'). Empty array on a clean parse.

decode_outcome.description: Implementation-reported decode outcome. 'parse_error' covers wrapper crash / FileNotFoundError (binary missing) / parser exception; 'decode_error' is a clean rejection by the decoder; 'no_qr_found' is the decoder cleanly reporting that no QR symbol was located in the image; 'ok' is a clean decode.
